records.key: Add a group with the values chosen above; columns left at Any are pooled.
records.source: Add a group with the values chosen above; columns left at Any are pooled.
records.translation: Lägg till en grupp med värdena som valts ovan; kolumner som lämnas på Alla slås samman.

records.key: Add an empty page after this one.
records.source: Add an empty page after this one.
records.translation: Lägg till en tom sida efter denna.

records.key: Adds to this channel's display level after the levels, from -100 to 100 percent of the display range.
records.source: Adds to this channel's display level after the levels, from -100 to 100 percent of the display range.
records.translation: Läggs till denna kanals visningsnivå efter nivåerna, från -100 till 100 procent av visningsintervallet.

records.key: Channel the per-channel settings are edited for: the advanced normalization, the percentile stretch, every enhancement step and the CMY/CMYK ink intensity. Pick a channel, change its values and press Apply settings to channel; channels marked (own settings) have their own values, the others follow All channels.
records.source: Channel the per-channel settings are edited for: the advanced normalization, the percentile stretch, every enhancement step and the CMY/CMYK ink intensity. Pick a channel, change its values and press Apply settings to channel; channels marked (own settings) have their own values, the others follow All channels.
records.translation: Den kanal som inställningarna per kanal redigeras för: den avancerade normaliseringen, percentilsträckningen, varje förbättringssteg och bläckintensiteten för CMY/CMYK. Välj en kanal, ändra dess värden och tryck på Tillämpa inställningar på kanalen; kanaler markerade (egna inställningar) har egna värden, de övriga följer Alla kanaler.

records.key: Channels the image enhancement applies to; a channel switched off is shown without enhancement.
records.source: Channels the image enhancement applies to; a channel switched off is shown without enhancement.
records.translation: Kanaler som bildförbättringen tillämpas på; en avstängd kanal visas utan förbättring.

records.key: Choose wells and fields, place each well on the page and choose what is printed around it, then preview and write a PDF.
records.source: Choose wells and fields, place each well on the page and choose what is printed around it, then preview and write a PDF.
records.translation: Välj brunnar och bildfält, placera varje brunn på sidan och välj vad som skrivs ut runt den, förhandsgranska sedan och skriv en PDF.

records.key: Clear every selected field and well.
records.source: Clear every selected field and well.
records.translation: Rensa alla markerade bildfält och brunnar.

records.key: Colour saturation of this image's combined colour image, all channels together (it is not set per channel): 0 percent is grey, 100 percent unchanged, higher more vivid.
records.source: Colour saturation of this image's combined colour image, all channels together (it is not set per channel): 0 percent is grey, 100 percent unchanged, higher more vivid.
records.translation: Färgmättnad för denna bilds sammansatta färgbild, alla kanaler tillsammans (den anges inte per kanal): 0 procent är grått, 100 procent oförändrat, högre mer livfullt.

records.key: Compare groups separately within each value of this annotation column.
records.source: Compare groups separately within each value of this annotation column.
records.translation: Jämför grupper separat inom varje värde i denna annoteringskolumn.

records.key: Copy this image's settings, for the selected channel or for all channels, to the other images of its well, its plate or every loaded image.
records.source: Copy this image's settings, for the selected channel or for all channels, to the other images of its well, its plate or every loaded image.
records.translation: Kopiera denna bilds inställningar, för den markerade kanalen eller för alla kanaler, till de andra bilderna i dess brunn, dess platta eller varje inläst bild.

records.key: Display level shown as black for this channel of this image; lower levels are clipped. Drag the black handle under the histogram or type a level from 0 to 1.
records.source: Display level shown as black for this channel of this image; lower levels are clipped. Drag the black handle under the histogram or type a level from 0 to 1.
records.translation: Visningsnivå som visas som svart för denna kanal i denna bild; lägre nivåer klipps. Dra det svarta handtaget under histogrammet eller skriv en nivå från 0 till 1.

records.key: Display level shown at full brightness for this channel of this image; higher levels are clipped. Drag the white handle or type a level from 0 to 1.
records.source: Display level shown at full brightness for this channel of this image; higher levels are clipped. Drag the white handle or type a level from 0 to 1.
records.translation: Visningsnivå som visas med full ljusstyrka för denna kanal i denna bild; högre nivåer klipps. Dra det vita handtaget eller skriv en nivå från 0 till 1.

records.key: Draw text boxes and drop images on a page grid, then write a PDF.
records.source: Draw text boxes and drop images on a page grid, then write a PDF.
records.translation: Rita textrutor och släpp bilder på ett sidrutnät, skriv sedan en PDF.

records.key: Draw the group comparison figure and tables, or show one representative image per group.
records.source: Draw the group comparison figure and tables, or show one representative image per group.
records.translation: Rita figuren och tabellerna för gruppjämförelsen, eller visa en representativ bild per grupp.

records.key: Draw the selected boxes above every other box.
records.source: Draw the selected boxes above every other box.
records.translation: Rita de markerade rutorna ovanför alla andra rutor.

records.key: Draw the selected boxes below every other box.
records.source: Draw the selected boxes below every other box.
records.translation: Rita de markerade rutorna under alla andra rutor.

records.key: Draw the selected boxes one step higher.
records.source: Draw the selected boxes one step higher.
records.translation: Rita de markerade rutorna ett steg högre.

records.key: Draw the selected boxes one step lower.
records.source: Draw the selected boxes one step lower.
records.translation: Rita de markerade rutorna ett steg lägre.

records.key: Every field of each chosen well at the shown time and Z.
records.source: Every field of each chosen well at the shown time and Z.
records.translation: Varje bildfält i varje vald brunn vid den visade tidpunkten och Z.

records.key: Every well whose annotation or comparison group matches a ticked condition.
records.source: Every well whose annotation or comparison group matches a ticked condition.
records.translation: Varje brunn vars annotering eller jämförelsegrupp matchar ett ikryssat villkor.

records.key: Field of view shown for each well.
records.source: Field of view shown for each well.
records.translation: Bildfält som visas för varje brunn.

records.key: Fill the groups with every combination of the ticked values, or vary one column and hold the others.
records.source: Fill the groups with every combination of the ticked values, or vary one column and hold the others.
records.translation: Fyll grupperna med alla kombinationer av de markerade värdena, eller variera en kolumn och håll de övriga.

records.key: Gamma between the black and white points: above 1 brightens the mid-tones, below 1 darkens them. The middle handle is the level shown as mid-grey.
records.source: Gamma between the black and white points: above 1 brightens the mid-tones, below 1 darkens them. The middle handle is the level shown as mid-grey.
records.translation: Gammavärde mellan svart- och vitpunkten: över 1 ljusar upp mellantonerna, under 1 gör dem mörkare. Det mittersta handtaget är den nivå som visas som mellangrå.

records.key: Give the selected group a name; its images and representative are shown under that name.
records.source: Give the selected group a name; its images and representative are shown under that name.
records.translation: Ge den markerade gruppen ett namn; dess bilder och representativa bild visas under det namnet.

records.key: Group whose images define the advanced normalization bounds.
records.source: Group whose images define the advanced normalization bounds.
records.translation: Grupp vars bilder bestämmer gränserna för den avancerade normaliseringen.

records.key: Groups compared, in order, with their labels and image counts; add, remove and reorder them here.
records.source: Groups compared, in order, with their labels and image counts; add, remove and reorder them here.
records.translation: Jämförda grupper i ordning, med sina etiketter och antal bilder; lägg till, ta bort och ordna om dem här.

records.key: Make Masks' Cellpose 3 denoising, deblurring or one-click restoration, applied to Original images; the model is installed and loaded through the Model Zoo.
records.source: Make Masks' Cellpose 3 denoising, deblurring or one-click restoration, applied to Original images; the model is installed and loaded through the Model Zoo.
records.translation: Brusreducering, borttagning av oskärpa eller återställning med ett klick med Cellpose 3 från Make Masks, tillämpad på bilder som öppnats med Originalupplösning; modellen installeras och läses in via Model Zoo.

records.key: Make Masks' calibrated or measured point spread function, applied to Original images after background subtraction.
records.source: Make Masks' calibrated or measured point spread function, applied to Original images after background subtraction.
records.translation: Kalibrerad eller uppmätt punktspridningsfunktion från Make Masks, tillämpad på bilder som öppnats med Originalupplösning efter bakgrundssubtraktion.

records.key: Move this page one place earlier.
records.source: Move this page one place earlier.
records.translation: Flytta denna sida ett steg tidigare.

records.key: Move this page one place later.
records.source: Move this page one place later.
records.translation: Flytta denna sida ett steg senare.

records.key: Off: an edit changes only the selected channel. On: the same edit is made to every channel of this image.
records.source: Off: an edit changes only the selected channel. On: the same edit is made to every channel of this image.
records.translation: Av: en ändring påverkar endast den markerade kanalen. På: samma ändring görs i varje kanal i denna bild.

records.key: Per channel, which images share one display stretch: each image on its own, each well, each plate, or all loaded plates. Wider scopes use sampled pixels: at most 64 images per scope and 4096 pixels per image.
records.source: Per channel, which images share one display stretch: each image on its own, each well, each plate, or all loaded plates. Wider scopes use sampled pixels: at most 64 images per scope and 4096 pixels per image.
records.translation: Per kanal, vilka bilder som delar en visningssträckning: varje bild för sig, varje brunn, varje platta eller alla inlästa plattor. Bredare omfång använder provtagna pixlar: högst 64 bilder per omfång och 4096 pixlar per bild.

records.key: Place the selected fields, or the fields of the selected wells, on this page.
records.source: Place the selected fields, or the fields of the selected wells, on this page.
records.translation: Placera de markerade bildfälten, eller de markerade brunnarnas bildfält, på denna sida.

records.key: Plate shown in the plate view.
records.source: Plate shown in the plate view.

records.key: Remove every group; comparisons then use the ticked values.
records.source: Remove every group; comparisons then use the ticked values.
records.translation: Ta bort alla grupper; jämförelser använder då de markerade värdena.

records.key: Remove this page and its boxes.
records.source: Remove this page and its boxes.
records.translation: Ta bort denna sida och dess rutor.

records.key: Restrict the plate view to one column, or show every column.
records.source: Restrict the plate view to one column, or show every column.
records.translation: Begränsa plattvyn till en kolumn, eller visa alla kolumner.

records.key: Restrict the plate view to one row, or show every row.
records.source: Restrict the plate view to one row, or show every row.
records.translation: Begränsa plattvyn till en rad, eller visa alla rader.

records.key: Show this channel in this image; switched off, the channel is left out of the composite.
records.source: Show this channel in this image; switched off, the channel is left out of the composite.
records.translation: Visa denna kanal i denna bild; avstängd utelämnas kanalen från den sammansatta bilden.

records.key: Stretches this channel about mid-grey after the levels: 100 percent leaves it unchanged, lower flattens, higher steepens.
records.source: Stretches this channel about mid-grey after the levels: 100 percent leaves it unchanged, lower flattens, higher steepens.
records.translation: Sträcker denna kanal kring mellangrått efter nivåerna: 100 procent lämnar den oförändrad, lägre plattar ut, högre gör brantare.

records.key: The first fields of each well, as many as set.
records.source: The first fields of each well, as many as set.
records.translation: De första bildfälten i varje brunn, så många som angetts.

records.key: Tick the fields to export in each well.
records.source: Tick the fields to export in each well.
records.translation: Kryssa i de bildfält som ska exporteras i varje brunn.
Kryssa i de brunnar som ska exporteras.

records.key: Time point shown for time-lapse acquisitions.
records.source: Time point shown for time-lapse acquisitions.

records.key: Value, or Any, of each annotation column in the next group; Any pools that column.
records.source: Value, or Any, of each annotation column in the next group; Any pools that column.
records.translation: Värde, eller Alla, för varje annoteringskolumn i nästa grupp; Alla slår samman den kolumnen.

records.key: Z plane shown when the Z mode is a single plane.
records.source: Z plane shown when the Z mode is a single plane.
records.translation: Z-plan som visas när Z-läget är ett enda plan.
